page: OVHcloud c2-60 is a compute-optimized server powered by an Intel x86_64 processor based on the Haswell architecture, running on a KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.0 GHz, with no hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 60.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.75 GB of memory per core, alongside a local 400 GB SSD and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the c2-60 in the average performance tier for most multi-core and data-processing workloads. It achieves a multi-core stress-ng score of 24,461.89 and a Passmark CPU score of 24,191.73. Single-core performance is relatively weaker, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,093.0, though multi-threaded tasks like bzip3 decompression at 142.69 GB/sec and software compilation via Clang at 15,531.0 perform within the middle tier. Memory bandwidth is measured at 120.4 GB/sec for large block reads and 45.09 GB/sec for writes.

The lack of hyper-threading and modern instruction sets like AVX-512 limits its efficiency in advanced vector math or heavy AI inference, as shown by the weak 6.54 tokens/sec text generation speed on a 7B LLM. However, with dedicated CPU allocation, a 400 GB local SSD, and stable Redis SET performance of 25.27 million operations per second, this server is well-suited for parallelized compute tasks, web serving, software compilation, and standard database operations that benefit from dedicated physical cores without resource sharing.
description: The OVHcloud c2-60 is a compute-optimized server featuring 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs on an Intel x86_64 Haswell architecture with a 3.0 GHz clock speed. It is configured with 60.0 GB of RAM (3.75 GB per core), a local 400 GB SSD, and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the instance delivers stable, mid-tier multi-core performance, as evidenced by a Passmark CPU score of 24,191.73 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 24,461.89. While single-core performance and advanced vector processing are limited due to the older architecture and lack of hyper-threading, the dedicated resource allocation ensures consistent execution. The c2-60 is suitable for parallelized workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations.
